title: Game Preservation: The Piracy Dilemma

scenes.text: Is piracy the only way to preserve video games?
Many classic games face extinction due to lost copyrights and data.
The Video Game History Foundation highlights piracy as a means to save them.
Game developers face tough choices: profit or preservation? Choose wisely.
